hypothesis: Diffusion Model generates novel data instances under distribution shift to demonstrate autonomy in producing behavior-aligned outputs without explicit retraining
description: The method leverages latent space interpolation and noise-based exploration to create synthetic examples that reflect shifted input distributions, enabling the model to adapt its generative behavior autonomously; by conditioning on learned representations rather than task-specific labels, it avoids overfitting to the original data distribution and maintains generalization, suggesting a pathway for robust autonomy in changing environments
